# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v1.0.0

这是行舟的首个 1.0 大版本。它在原有项目事务与生活节律之外加入营养摄入追踪，并系统优化了执行切片、平板布局和触控体验。

## 主要更新

- “生活节律”新增“营养摄入”：按日汇总热量、蛋白质、碳水和脂肪，不区分餐次，适合快速记录增肌减脂期间的大致摄入。
- 支持每日热量与蛋白质目标、进度和剩余量，并显示三大宏量营养素的近似热量占比。
- 支持自建常用食物模板。点击即可按基准量记录，也可输入本次实际重量、容量或数量；例如模板基准为 113 ml、实际喝了 98 ml 时，插件会按 `98 / 113` 自动换算全部营养数据。
- 当日记录可直接修改实际摄入量。模板修改或删除不会影响历史快照，旧份数数据也会自动兼容。
- 营养数据独立保存在 `nutrition.json`，使用三份轮换备份和写后完整性复核，不读取或修改思源文档。
- 执行切片日历显示每天的切片数和预计分钟数；平板紧凑视图优先显示预计时间，日历对比度也已增强。
- 大幅压缩插件顶部与执行切片顶部的无效空白，并针对鸿蒙平板重做详情列、层级浏览和触控布局。
- 修复已有切片时无法清除截止日期的问题；只有新的具体截止日期早于已有切片时才会阻止保存。

## 升级说明

本版本兼容现有工作项、生活节律和 Checklist 数据。首次进入营养摄入时会创建新的独立数据文件，无需手工迁移。建议升级后分别在桌面和平板检查一次营养模板、按量记录、执行切片日历和事务详情布局。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v1.0.0

This is Xingzhou's first 1.0 major release. It adds nutrition intake tracking alongside Projects & Tasks and Life Rhythm, while substantially improving execution slices, tablet layouts, and touch interaction.

## Highlights

- Added Nutrition Intake to Life Rhythm, totaling calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat by day without meal categories for fast, approximate bulking or cutting records.
- Added optional daily calorie and protein goals, progress and remaining feedback, plus approximate macro calorie shares.
- Added reusable food templates. Log the base amount in one tap or enter an actual weight, volume, or quantity for proportional calculation. For example, a 113 ml template recorded as 98 ml automatically scales every nutrition value by `98 / 113`.
- Daily entries allow direct actual-amount changes. Template edits and deletion never alter historical snapshots, and legacy serving-based data remains compatible.
- Nutrition lives in an independent `nutrition.json` store with three rotating backups and read-after-write integrity verification; no SiYuan document is read or modified for nutrition tracking.
- Execution-slice calendars now show daily slice counts and estimated minutes. Compact tablet layouts prioritize time, with stronger calendar contrast.
- Removed substantial wasted space from the plugin and execution-slice headers, and redesigned detail panes, hierarchy browsing, and touch behavior for HarmonyOS tablets.
- Fixed existing slices incorrectly preventing a deadline from being cleared. Only a new concrete deadline earlier than an existing slice is rejected.

## Upgrade notes

Existing work-item, Life Rhythm, and Checklist data remain compatible. Nutrition creates a new independent data file on first use, with no manual migration required. After upgrading, it is worth checking templates, actual-amount logging, the execution-slice calendar, and transaction details once on both desktop and tablet.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
